crossRefs.note: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

translations.web: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
translations.bsb: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution—life for life.
translations.kjv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
translations.asv: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.
